name: osct
description: Skills for auditing repositories, filing issues, opening and reviewing pull requests, addressing review comments, and writing documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Handle the work around an open-source change.
interface.longDescription: Audit a repository, file focused issues, open and review pull requests, address reviewer comments, and keep documentation accurate.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and draft the most valuable issues.
Open a concise pull request for the current change.
Address the reviewer comments on this pull request.
